 inside the nets 
 The colliding forces sabotaging the Nets’ attempt to play defense 
 By 
 Brian Lewis 
 Published 
 Oct. 27, 2026, 3:00 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make New York Post a Preferred Source 
 Pacers forward Larry Nance Jr. (22) shoots over Moritz Wagner (13), Michael Porter Jr. (17) and Julius Randle (30) during the Nets' 136-109 loss on Oct. 25, 2026. 
 Corey Sipkin for the NY Post 
 The Nets’ sieve-like defense has been offensive.
 Yes, the sample size is small. But going into Tuesday’s tilt in Boston, the winless Nets have a defense problem .
 Effort. Communication. Cohesion. Name it, and the Nets have been lacking.
 And most concerning of all, the Nets’ personnel shortcomings are almost certainly a season-long concern.
